definitions: To take in or soak up (liquid, gas, or other substance) by chemical or physical action.
To take in and incorporate (information, experiences, or ideas).
To reduce the effect or intensity of (sound, light, or energy).
To fully engage the attention of (someone); engross.
examples: The sponge began to absorb the water.
She tried to absorb all the new information.
The curtains help to absorb the sound.
The story began to absorb his attention.
The company decided to absorb the shipping costs.
